steps.label: 3097-own-single216-history-modal-dismiss
command: (async()=>{const m=document.querySelector('#twinHistoryModal'),i=bootstrap.Modal.getInstance(m);if(!m.classList.contains('show')||i._isTransitioning)throw Error('Stable history modal required');const done=new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const timer=setTimeout(()=>reject(Error('History hide timeout')),7000);m.addEventListener('hidden.bs.modal',()=>{clearTimeout(timer);resolve();},{once:true});});m.querySelector('[data-bs-dismiss=modal]').click();await done;return {visibleModals:[...document.querySelectorAll('.modal.show')].map(e=>e.id)};})()

steps.label: 3100-own-single216-discarded387-filter-search
command: (()=>{if(new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('itemId')!=='2089216'||!document.querySelector('#itemTwinModal.show')||document.querySelector('#twinAddTabBtn').getAttribute('aria-selected')!=='true')throw Error('Expected own Add tab');const f=document.querySelector('#twinSearchFilter');if(f.querySelector('[name=keywordType]').value!=='itemId')throw Error('ID filter required');const k=f.querySelector('[name=keyword]');k.value='2089387';k.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));for(const c of f.querySelectorAll('[name=statuses]'))if(c.checked!==(c.value==='D'))c.click();const b=f.querySelector('button[hx-get]');if(!b)throw Error('Search missing');b.click();return {keyword:k.value,checkedStatuses:[...f.querySelectorAll('[name=statuses]:checked')].map(e=>e.value),searchPath:b.getAttribute('hx-get')};})()

steps.label: 3103-own-single216-final-twin-modal-dismiss
command: (async()=>{const m=document.querySelector('#itemTwinModal'),i=bootstrap.Modal.getInstance(m);if(!m.classList.contains('show')||i._isTransitioning)throw Error('Stable twin modal required');const done=new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const timer=setTimeout(()=>reject(Error('Twin hide timeout')),7000);m.addEventListener('hidden.bs.modal',()=>{clearTimeout(timer);resolve();},{once:true});});m.querySelector('.modal-header [data-bs-dismiss=modal]').click();await done;return {visibleModals:[...document.querySelectorAll('.modal.show')].map(e=>e.id)};})()
